Customizable chains: planting, cooking, serving. A system of employees with endurance and experience parameters. Financial indicators, graphs, analytics by departments. Deep automation and no manual pressure.

Leaps to wealth

The signature element is a helmet with a flying device. It allows you to soar over precipices and feel like the hero of a corporate dream. But the path to retirement isn't easy: each level tests your patience, sense of humor, and ability to look at difficulties with a smile.

21606.description:
Detective Worden is a noir word puzzle where the city speaks in hints and the truth lurks in the shadows. Letters become clues, phrases become proof, and guesswork is the only weapon. You must unravel a case in which truth and lies sound equally convincing if you don't know where to look for the answer.

Investigation through words

An unknown informant sends you short messages — fragments of an old case file. You must piece together the details, search for logic, and build chains of cause and effect, where meaning lies in the order of the letters. The atmosphere is permeated with rain, the clatter of keys, and the smell of stale tobacco, creating a feeling of loneliness and inner tension.

History gradually reveals clues leading to a solution, but the path to the truth is convoluted. In this game, you can't rely on chance: the slightest mistake and you lose the trail. Your mind is the only instrument capable of sorting through the chaos of words and seeing the cold structure of truth behind them. Everything else is just noise and smoke.

Features of the game

Noir atmosphere and style of the 40s with a dark narrative. Unique puzzles that combine deduction and word analysis. Visual design with a typewriter and the sound of rain outside the window. A narrative that reveals the story through text and the player's subconscious.

21848.description:
Bloodface is a dark action RPG set in a semi-open medieval world. After the fall of the monarchy, the country descends into chaos: armies have disintegrated, gangs have taken over cities, and everyone is fighting for survival. The player takes on the role of a warrior who must restore order and justice, relying on strength, strategy, and melee weapons.

World and plot

The world is filled with threats and secrets. Explore ruined villages, dark forests, and desolate castles. Civil war has destroyed the old order, and every player choice affects the balance of power. Fight for the people or join the bandits. Decide who deserves to live and who must fall, for the fate of the world rests in your hands.

The combat system demands precision and endurance. Striking, blocking, and dodging are all important. Each weapon type has its own advantages and animations. Develop your skills, upgrade your equipment, and unlock new combat moves. Battles are challenging but fair, and each victorious encounter makes you stronger and more experienced.

Features of the game

Open world with dynamic events and active NPCs. A tactical combat system based on timing and endurance. Character development through skills, abilities and equipment. Moral choices that impact the plot and environment.

A Storied Life: Tabitha is a story about memory, legacy, and the quiet joy of discovery. After the death of a loved one, you are left with an old country house and a letter asking you to sell everything of value. An accident destroyed the unpublished memoirs, but hidden among the belongings left in the rooms are fragments of the past that can be reassembled and the story of your life rewritten.

A thoughtful farewell

Room by room, you explore the house: moving furniture, peering into drawers, lifting rugs, and finding forgotten objects. Each one requires a decision — to keep as a memory, to auction, or to dispose of. The space gradually reveals a person's character through everyday details and hidden treasures.

The collected items become words for reconstructing the memoir. By filling in the blanks, you shape the narrative tone — light, ironic, sad, or inspiring. The final version of the story influences the final scenes, turning the process of tidying into a personal act of preserving or reinterpreting the past.

Calamity Angels: Special Delivery — is an unusual RPG adventure about a group of eccentric couriers who travel the Orkotris region, delivering packages to the most dangerous locations. The job proves far more challenging than a typical delivery: the route leads through wild lands inhabited by monsters and rival agencies. The player assembles a team, plans routes, and escorts the shipment to its destination, striving to fulfill the order despite all the unexpected.

Delivery under threat

Before each mission, the player receives a new package and must prepare the team for the journey. They must check the contents, pack the cargo properly, and select equipment for the couriers. Along the way, they may encounter monsters or rivals who will try to disrupt the delivery, so it's important to plan your strategy and team composition in advance.

During a trip, the team's mood plays a crucial role. Couriers may ignore commands, argue among themselves, or act unexpectedly. Sometimes such improvisations help resolve difficult situations, but sometimes they create additional problems. Managing mood becomes part of the strategy.

ZPF — is a classic arcade horizontal shooter built around dodging, a dense stream of enemies, and precise ship control. The game immediately sets a high pace: the space is filled with projectiles, and any mistake quickly results in the loss of the attempt.

Reaction and positioning

The main goal is to maintain control of the situation, moving between dense attack patterns while dealing damage. Enemies appear in waves, forcing you to constantly reposition and choose safe trajectories. Combat requires not only speed but also an understanding of attack patterns to identify safe zones in advance.

The choice of character influences your playstyle. Each character has their own set of attacks and abilities that change the way you approach combat. Additional upgrades between levels allow you to increase your firepower and adapt to more challenging levels. Gradually, the game transitions from simple survival to a polished playstyle where every second and every move counts.

A fast-paced horizontal shooter. Different characters with unique attacks. Bosses with distinct behavior patterns. Secrets and upgrades between levels.

23905.description:
Alchemist: Journey of the Soul — This is a first-person adventure with co-op, ancient laboratories, and alchemy, where you must delve ever deeper into the secrets of others for the sake of a single goal. The Alchemist created you for a reason. He speaks of the Philosopher's Stone, of the soul, of a great destiny. And the further your journey goes, the more it seems as if you are just another ingredient for him, like everything else in his workshop.

Alchemical trace

Castles, monasteries, and old halls with broken flasks and strange symbols look like someone spent years trying to create something here that shouldn't even exist. You have to search for recipes everywhere, gather rare ingredients, and tinker with cauldrons, because many problems here can't be solved with a regular sword or key. Make a mistake with the brew, and you'll end up with a useless sludge. Do everything right, and you'll unlock a new ability or a passage further down the line.

The closer you get to the Philosopher's Stone, the more unpleasant the answers become. Old notes, abandoned rooms, and the Alchemist's own behavior begin to form a completely different picture. And at some point, you no longer know what's worse: losing your soul or discovering the price they're going to pay to give you one.

Features of the game

A cooperative adventure for up to 4 players. Alchemy, recipes and brewing potions. Exploration of castles, ruins and monasteries. Magical abilities and puzzles.

24719.description:
VOIDFACE — is a brutal arcade shooter that turns a typical gunfight into a true test of endurance. There are no hordes of weak opponents: each one is capable of putting up a full-blown fight, and the screen quickly fills with bullets that you have to literally squeeze through. You only have one life, so a careless move can end your entire run.

Take down your enemy before he takes down you

Bosses don't just withstand a huge number of hits; they can be destroyed gradually, dismantling individual parts and depriving the enemy of their usual attack methods. Each encounter has its own set of moves and carefully constructed bullet patterns, so over time, you begin to not just guess, but actually read the battle and anticipate where you can move.

Spells add another tool to battles, but they don't guarantee victory on their own. Some abilities are easier to use, while others require a keen understanding of timing and positioning in the arena. Completing the game unlocks hats and illustrations, allowing you to add a touch of personality to a game built around brutal combat.

Features of the game
Each enemy acts as an independent boss. Dense projectile patterns require precise dodging. Bosses can be gradually stripped of individual parts and attacks. Spells open up additional ways to survive dangerous encounters.
